decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks fit the firm's dental materials and thermoforming know-how closely, so its existing R&D and sales channels give it good scope to refine and commercialise the line rather than withdraw it.
A PETG thermoforming blank sits squarely in the firm's established dental laboratory materials business, making it highly compatible with its production knowledge, quality systems, and customer base.

UV-curing lacquer is related to the firm's materials expertise but appears less prominently positioned, so it faces more risk than the core launches even though the firm still has the knowledge base to improve it.

Intraoral contrast spray supports digital dental workflows, which matches the firm's strategic direction and gives it strong absorptive capacity to learn from early market feedback and keep developing the product.

A custom earmold product line builds directly on the firm's long-standing custom-device capabilities in hearing care, so management would be inclined to retain and optimise it rather than exit quickly.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are an adjacent extension of the firm's earmold expertise and channel relationships, so they are likely to be kept, though the somewhat broader application makes them a bit more uncertain than core hearing products.
